passages/puppy: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "On the way home from school, Isla heard a faint whimper coming from behind the wall of the old church. She peered over and saw a small brown puppy, shivering and soaked from the rain. There was no collar on its neck. Isla wrapped the puppy in her scarf and carried it carefully home. Her dad phoned the vet, who checked the puppy for a microchip. It belonged to Mrs Reid, who lived three streets away. When Mrs Reid arrived, she hugged Isla and the puppy at the same time. \"Bramble has been missing for two days,\" she said, wiping her eyes. \"You are a real hero.\""]
